summary: Five glass surfaces at elevations 1 to 5, from Ultra thin to Chrome, over a three color gradient.
use: Choosing the glass tier by how much blur and fill a panel needs over its background.
spec: `{#each tiers as tier (tier.elevation)}` renders 5 `<Surface material="glass" elevation={tier.elevation} class="tier">`
Tiers: Ultra thin (`elevation: 1`), Thin (`elevation: 2`), Regular (`elevation: 3`), Thick (`elevation: 4`), Chrome (`elevation: 5`)
Each tier shows a `label` and a `desc`, for example Subtle background hint and Heaviest blur and fill
